digest.component_or_area: config sources and resolvers module structure
propositions: src/rebar/_config_sources.py at 791 LOC exceeds the 720 LOC near-cap warning band and risks breaking CI on the next config change
The module contains two separable concerns: raw-input resolution layer (lines 31-361) and RP-04 below-seam owned resolvers (lines 364-791), already marked by in-file banner comments

The resolver half reaches back into the raw-input half only through _snapshot_table calling user_config_path, _read_toml_table, and _discover_project_config, requiring late binding through module attributes to preserve monkeypatch semantics

Moving the 24 resolver entry points and 5 private symbols to a new _config_resolvers.py module splits the 791 LOC file into two files (403 and 480 LOC) each under 500 LOC with headroom under the 800 cap
All 29 moved names must remain re-exported from _config_sources.py to preserve the public import surface and existing call sites
